recall_precision_decomposition.definition: For each category and IoU, retain the existing TP matches and delete all FPs. Ceiling is the fraction of the original 101 recall levels <= AR100 (zero if AR100=0); exclude no-GT categories. AP=ceiling-FP precision loss. Fixed predictions/maxDets; no new matching or recovered detections. This is a numerical identity, not a causal separation of model abilities.
